newsitem.title: USA: Atmos /United Cities merger closing delayed.
newsitem.headline: Atmos /United Cities merger closing delayed.

text.p: Atmos Energy Corp and United Cities Gas Co said Monday they have extended the period for closing their merger to Aug 31, pending completion of regulatory approvals in Illinois and Missouri. The merger agreement had originally called for a closing by March 31.
The companies now expect to get the neeeded regulatory approvals in June or July of this year, said United Cities.
Shareholders of both companies have already approved the merger, in which Atmos will be the surviving entity.

United Cities distributes natural gas and propane gas to approximately 340,000 customers in 10 states. Atmos provides natural gas service to more than 680,000 customers in Texas, Colorado, Kansas, Missouri, Louisiana and Kentucky.
